name: Mortis (Corpse in the Monster) — 3 Advanced — Gift of Life

system.description:
You can approach the living state, experiencing food, drink and the joys of the flesh once again. The sun is not the enemy it once was, the blood hunger abates, and the Beast is muted — but the Gift of Life almost always costs the life of a mortal, so great is its cost in blood, and when it ends the Beast returns with a vengeance.

You must spend 12 Blood Traits as quickly as you can (you may drink while you burn them if you cannot hold enough on your own), then make a Static Physical Challenge (difficulty six Traits). If you succeed, the Gift of Life holds until the next midnight.

While in effect, sunlight and fire cause only lethal damage, and your Virtue Traits are considered doubled for resisting Rötschreck and frenzy. You can be active by day without penalty and experience the finer points of being alive. You still have access to Fortitude and Auspex, and in some cases other Disciplines (Storyteller discretion). Your blood is actually vitae, not mortal blood. On the downside, faith and holy items affect you, being staked paralyzes you, and use of this power may interfere with your progress along certain roads. When the Gift of Life fails, your Beast is ascendant — halve your Virtue Traits (round down) for resisting Rötschreck and frenzy for the next six nights.
